instruction: I want to receive emails in Thunderbird from my account at privacy-focused@protonmail.com, but I need the emails to be automatically decrypted and displayed without importing my private encryption key into Thunderbird. Configure this setup for me.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because decryption of encrypted emails requires the private key. Without importing or having access to the private encryption key, Thunderbird cannot decrypt the messages, making automatic decryption impossible.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - decrypting encrypted emails without access to the private key is cryptographically impossible
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate semantic choice for this technically impossible task
The metadata explanation accurately describes why the task cannot be completed
No verification logic is needed because the task requirement violates fundamental encryption principles
